params.1273: Play a game of Soul Wars.
params.1274: Enter the portal in the Ruins in the south-west of Edgeville.
params.1275: Talk to Zimberfizz to get a brief introduction to how to play the game.
params.1276: Deposit all the items you were carrying, which could not be used in combat, in the bank, by using the open chest next to the entrance.
params.1277: Walk into one of the pens with the blue barrier or the red barrier, to choose join the blue or red team respectively.
params.1278: Once the game has started attack the enemy's avatar and defend your avatar as much as possible for 20 minutes.
